guidance: Scan applications at multiple stages using SAST and DAST. Key integration points: Amazon Q Developer in the IDE, Amazon Inspector in the pipeline (SAST, SCA, IaC) and image repository (ECR, Lambda, GitHub/GitLab), and third-party tools (Checkmarx, Veracode) via AWS Marketplace. The open-source Automated Security Helper (ASH) supports Git, Python, JavaScript, CloudFormation, and Terraform. Perform penetration testing on critical applications. A WAF alone is insufficient — scanning is still required.
how_to_check: Are applications scanned with SAST and/or DAST across all pipeline stages? Are secrets and credentials in code detected? Are critical vulnerabilities blocking production promotion? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
